properties.name: FREE DATA TERRA-REF MAC
properties.note: Public research data (TERRA-REF, Maricopa Agricultural Center, Arizona; public domain), not a Dos Ojos field and not the Rio Grande Valley. The outline is the field scanner's own strip, drawn from USGS aerial imagery, not supplied by TERRA-REF. It is 24 m wide, which is two Sentinel-2 pixels: read the satellite side as an illustration, not a measurement.
